text: TTH offers a conversion using supplied original Porsche/BorgWarner K16 cores with size-8 hot housings. It advertises up to 650 PS with appropriate engine components and recalibration. It provides no measured map, operating speed envelope or test configuration on the consulted page. Research record: [AUTHORED-004].

TTH reports a balance figure of 0.05 g. The page does not identify the associated radius, residual-unbalance unit such as g mm, speed-dependent acceptance limits or balance grade. Research record: [AUTHORED-005].

The TTH 750 PS product is based on K24 donors with size-10 hot housings. It is a different donor route from the K16-650 product, and its advertised power depends on engine components and software changes. Research record: [AUTHORED-006].
